sloka: सर्वथा सर्वभूतानां नास्ति मृत्युरलक्षणः ।तव तावदयं मृत्युर्मैथिलीकृतलक्षणः ।। ६.११४.२९ ।।
transliteration: sarvathā sarvabhūtānāṁ nāsti mṛtyuralakṣaṇaḥ ।tava tāvadayaṁ mṛtyurmaithilīkṛtalakṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.114.29 ।।

translations.english: "Death does not happen without reason for any being. To you this happened because of getting Mythili."
